title: SEKA Spear product page and specifications
notes: One Spear page covers the RDC and Standard frames. Specification block: max tire width (actual) 32 mm, 700c, BSA threaded 68 mm, headset bearings 49.5×40.5×6.5 mm 45/45°, thru-axles front L118.6 mm M12×P1.0 and rear L165.2 mm M12×P1.5, saddle clamp for 7×7, 7×9, 7×10 and 7×11 mm rails. Weights: RDC 685 g and Standard 780 g bare frame, 729 g ±35 g for a size-M Shadow Black frame; weights vary with paint and size. Manufacturer comparisons with Exceed RDC: 5% more stiffness, 14.5% better stiffness-to-weight, 23% more vertical compliance with up to 17 mm seatpost deflection. Five regular and two racing sizes (MR, LR); the page's geometry image matches the 2024–25 catalog table.
